## Completed example excerpt

> This repository contains the non-sensitive Quarto source, styles, tests and deployment workflow for an early public handbook. It does not contain participant data, confidential student cases or the private source conversation. Suggestions enter an editorial queue; submission does not authorise direct publication. The current site can be built with `quarto render`, and the last clean build is recorded in the release checklist.

## Scenario test

A new collaborator clones the repository. They can render the home page but not the full book because the README omits the required TeX engine and environment step. Add the missing setup instructions, test them from a fresh clone and record the successful build.
